outcome: adverse pregnancy outcomes (composite of stillbirth, preterm birth, or low birth weight)
cohort: The study included 197,722 singleton births at 20-42 weeks' gestation from participants enrolled in the National Free Preconception Health Examination Project in rural Yunnan province, China, between 2010 and 2018.
finding: Compared with women with medium education level, women with lower education level were more likely to experience adverse pregnancy outcomes, including stillbirth, and women with higher education level were also more likely to experience stillbirth.
